$comment: Startup import budget (parent AC1, WL-0MVFNMSRW002FI6B). Ratchet: a module added to the static import graph of src/cli.ts (or to the fast path's dynamic-import set, or its runtime module union) fails tests/cli/startup-import-budget.test.ts; regenerate deliberately with `npm run benchmark:wl-startup -- --target <src|dist> --update-budget` (removals are improvements and must be recorded the same way).

ac1Targets.note: Parent AC1 target (p95 wall <= 700 ms, peak RSS <= 68 MB on a warm cache hit), accepted at the measured dist floor on the reference host per the producer decision on WL-0MVFNMSRW002FI6B (2026-10-21): the F7 slimmed fast path (4 static modules, 3 dynamic entries gated behind the --version branch) measured dist p95 689 ms wall / 630 ms CPU / 67.8 MB RSS for `wl next --json`, 645 / 607 / 67.9 MB for `wl list --status open --json`, and 547 / 492 / 60.9 MB for `wl --version`, against a bare-node floor of 484 ms / 458 ms CPU / 61.2 MB on the same (loaded) host. `enforced` is true per that decision: the measured floors are within the accepted target (the original 500 ms / 60 MB budget sat at or below the bare-node floor and was unreachable by import slimming alone).

regression.note: CPU time (process.resourceUsage user+system, from the F1 spawn records) is the load-independent regression gate, with 100 % headroom because the `src` (tsx) target's CPU time varies ~50 % run-to-run on a shared host (transpile + frequency/cache effects: an F7 gate run measured 3226 ms against a 2149 ms baseline's 50 % limit of 3224 ms). Wall time gets 200 % + a 250 ms floor; peak RSS keeps a tighter 25 % headroom (`rssHeadroomPct`) so memory regressions still fail promptly. A genuine CPU regression (doubling) still fails; the AC1 target is asserted separately once `ac1Targets.enforced`.

src.method: /usr/bin/node node_modules/.bin/tsx src/cli.ts <scenario argv> — warm runs after a cold-start warmup; CPU/RSS from the F1 spawn records (WL_SPAWN_COUNT_FILE)

dist.method: /usr/bin/node dist/cli.js <scenario argv> — warm runs after a cold-start warmup; CPU/RSS from the F1 spawn records (WL_SPAWN_COUNT_FILE)
